mode: VERIFICATION (Thompson 1917 claim override) — not a new-model scout
claim: Human (and animal) heads/faces and proportions, in the Durer/Camper tradition, are mutually transformable by coordinate deformation; differences of facial angle/proportion are whole-grid deformations.
seed_paper: Thompson, D.W. (1917) On Growth and Form, Ch. XVII, pp. ~724-735, Figs. 353-358 (claim inventory citation)

page_figure_correction.note: The claim inventory cites pp. ~724-735 / Figs. 353-358. In the IA scan those pages (printed 729-731, leaves 748-750) carry the generic coordinate-transformation types (1)-(4): proportional stretch x1, c*y1 (Fig. 353), logarithmic stretch y -> eps^y (Figs. 355-356), simple shear x = xi - eta cot w, y = eta cosec w (Fig. 357), radial coordinates (Fig. 358). The Durer human-head grids that carry the actual claim are Fig. 364 (printed p. 740, leaf 759: three heads in rectangular proportion grids) and Fig. 366 (printed p. 742, leaf 761: two heads in oblique/sheared grids), with the Camper facial-angle footnote on p. 742. Leaf-to-printed-page offset verified empirically as leaf = printed page + 19 for this part of the scan (the queue's 'leaf - 20' is off by one here).

pre_scouted_dataset_pointer.title: Effect of the histone deacetylase inhibitor Trichostatin A on facial development in cichlid fishes
pre_scouted_dataset_pointer.verdict: DATASET_MISMATCH for this pointer: the Dryad hit is a geometric-morphometric study of Trichostatin-A-treated Lake Malawi cichlid craniofacial development (fish), not human facial-profile landmarks. It is recorded here and NOT used. The override's alternative — Thompson's own 1917 figures from the pinned IA scan — matches the claim exactly (Durer heads, Figs. 364 & 366) and is used as the primary claim source; real human profiles come from CC/PD Wikimedia Commons photographs (below).

specimens.ethics_note: Camper's facial-angle tradition was historically misused for racial ranking. This loop tests only Thompson's geometric claim (are inter-individual profile differences whole-grid affine deformations?); no population inference is made or implied.
